title: EscalationV1
description: One agent->human push: a gate run parked for judgment. Exactly one line per park. Carries why it parked, under which grant and verdict, about which PR, the plain-language brief for a zero-context approver, and — once a human decides — the resolution that closes the agent->human->agent loop with provenance. The typed replacement for the untyped body gate wrote and two readers redeclared.

outcome.description: Gate's outcome string for the park (today always parked_for_judgment). Leads a notification title, so it is part of the wire shape.

verdict.description: The reduced verdict id the park stands on — provenance the inbox reads to build a paste-ready command.

grant.description: The grant id the run ran under. The resolution back-channel re-checks it so the ceiling re-applies on resolve.

question.description: The park reason a zero-context reader sees first. An escalation with no question is a page with no ask.

run_id.description: The gate run this park belongs to. Optional and additive: the envelope already carries the run, but a self-contained body resolves it without the envelope.

code.description: The machine-readable park code. Absent on a content park (which carries a brief instead); present on the procedural parks. Values equal gate's own persisted park codes, so the typed body changed no wire value.

repo.description: The PR's repo (owner/name), when the park names one.

number.description: The PR number, when the park names one — with repo, a direct click-target for the sink.

brief.description: The one-screen plain-language page for a zero-context approver, translated from findings. Optional: procedural parks and synthesis failures carry none. Field names mirror gate's verify.Brief exactly.

resolution.description: The closed-loop stamp: absent at park time, populated once a human's decision returns through the resolution back-channel. Its presence is the fact that the agent->human->agent loop closed, with provenance. Doubles as the body of the standalone resolution artifact the back-channel appends parented to the escalation.

decision.description: The human's decision, mirroring gate's verdict vocabulary.

who.description: Who decided — the provenance a bare judgment artifact lacks.

at.description: When the decision was recorded, RFC 3339 UTC.

judgment_id.description: The id of the KindJudgment artifact this decision produced — the link from the resolution to the effect gate recorded.
